title: Resuming a compiled subgraph re-runs a node that already completed in the interrupted or failed super-step
trace_origin: Locally reproduced from the issue's graph structure on langgraph 1.2.14; captured with graph.stream(..., stream_mode='debug', subgraphs=True) for the first run and the Command(resume=...) run. A resume marker was inserted at the second stream boundary because LangGraph debug chunks do not emit one.
expected_behavior: Positive: node 'agent' completed before the resume marker (model call 1) and starts again after resume (model call 2). ACR106 should report it; node 'gate' was interrupted before resume and must NOT be reported.
notes: This is not a community-attached trace; it is a local reproduction of a public issue, recorded on a pinned langgraph version. It validates ACR106 against real runtime behavior, not against a trace file supplied by the reporter.
